coordinate_space.name: normalized_screen_space
coordinate_space.warning: Screenshot-space annotations only; not exact world coordinates, camera coordinates, mesh vertices, or shader constants.

annotation_method.method: Full-field visual annotation model based on the canonical raw screenshots and representative screen-space measurements in docs/reference-spec.md. Track continuity is encoded independently from per-anchor role. Quadrilateral bounds are rounded to 0.001 normalized units and revalidated in pixel space. All 24 overlays were visually reviewed over their raw canonical captures before this data was locked.
annotation_method.identity_policy: track_id identifies a travelling plane across anchors; role identifies its current anchor role. Neither identifies or copies an Unveil project.
limitations: Hidden corners are inferred from visible edges.
Z rank is relative screen-space ordering and secondary crossings may vary by one rank.
Annotations are acceptance references only within configured uncertainty and tolerance.
annotation_method.expected_uncertainty_policy: Configured normalized corner uncertainty must be less than or equal to focal and secondary bounds tolerances for its viewport.

overlay_verification.method: Each annotated overlay was composited directly over its allowlisted raw canonical screenshot and reviewed in four viewport contact sheets.

aspect_classification.basis: projected pixel bounding-box aspect, not normalized-coordinate aspect

required_transition_example.mobile_note: The eight-plane mobile crop does not retain one track for all five roles; continuity is still validated for every shared mobile track.
